findings.claim: The user-match check reads integration.metadata["sender"]["login"] without a guard. Integrations whose metadata lacks a 'sender' key (build_integration only adds it conditionally, and older or pre-existing integrations may not have it) raise a KeyError, which produces an HTTP 500.

verifier.reason: In src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py:501-505, GitHubInstallation.dispatch directly accesses integration.metadata["sender"]["login"] without guarding for missing keys. Because build_integration only sets metadata["sender"] when state.get("sender") is truthy (src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py:376-377) and ensure_integration overwrites metadata during normal pipeline completion without sender (src/sentry/integrations/pipeline.py:32-42), any active Integration lacking "sender" raises an unhandled KeyError resulting in an HTTP 500.

findings.claim: safe_urlopen() and get_user_info() (which calls raise_for_status()) are outside exception handling. Network errors or non-2xx responses during the token exchange or user fetch cause an unhandled 500 instead of the error() page.

verifier.reason: In OAuthLoginView.dispatch, safe_urlopen() (src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py:423) sits outside the try/except at lines 425-429, and get_user_info() (src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py:434), which calls resp.raise_for_status() (src/sentry/identity/github/provider.py:16), has no exception handling at all. Because neither Pipeline.current_step() nor PipelineAdvancerView catches requests exceptions, network errors or non-2xx responses from the user fetch propagate as an unhandled 500 instead of rendering the error() page.
